title: Location of the left edge
statement: For every natural number radius $R$ and every integer coordinate $z$, the guide tape of radius $R$ carries the left edge marker at $z$ if and only if $z=-R-1$.
replaced:
For every radius $R$ and every integer coordinate $z$, the guide tape of radius $R$
carries the left edge marker at $z$ if and only if $z = -R - 1$.
